description.value: Liberty Kitchen is a full-service restaurant in North Vancouver's Harbour Centre, operated under the Browns Restaurant Group franchise. It serves Italian-inspired food including pizza, with a weekend and holiday brunch offering. Group dining and party pre-order options are available, making it a reasonable stop for larger cycling groups passing through.
